title: Synthetic Biology and Metabolic Engineering: Principles and Practices for Next-Generation Bioproduction
description: This article provides a comprehensive guide to the principles of synthetic biology for metabolic engineers in research and drug development. It explores foundational concepts, details advanced methodologies including CRISPR-Cas and pathway engineering for applications from biofuels to pharmaceuticals, addresses key troubleshooting and optimization challenges in strain development, and reviews critical model validation and comparative analysis frameworks.
audience: Metabolic engineering researchers, scientists in drug development, and biotechnologists.
